description:
***No complete builds available. Framesets only.***

Fat bikes started out as a niche winter or beach bike and has become a stock mountain bike for some. A bke that looks to be 100 lbs with larger than life tires can actually ride lighter and more nimble than some with smaller. They come in many materials but we prefer steel. YOU can cover it in your choice of color.

Fashioned from Reynolds 853 main tubes and Columbus Omnicron rear stays, the Fat frame is handmade in Wisconsin by Waterford Precision Cycles. The newly-designed tapered head tube creates ultimate stiffness and control, the Fat was designed with a light carbon rigid fork in mind but a 100mm suspension would be excellent as well, plus it comes stock with semi-internal dropper post routing.

Current turn-around for a frame or complete bike is 8-10 weeks until shipment. This could be extended depending on options chosen. Please ask.

FEATURES AND INFORMATION

Designed And Developed By Milwaukee Bicycle Co. - Handmade By Waterford Precision Cycles.

TUBING

This Milwaukee Fat is built featuring Reynolds 853 main tubes and Columbus Omnicron rear stays. A Tapered headtube and downtube gusset was added for increased front end rigidity.

The geometry on this frame is designed to be at home in the snow and sand as well your best friend on fast technical trails. The 853 main tubes are stiff yet comfortable and married to a stiff rear end. We think you'll love this frame when are carving through any terrain.

PART INTEGRATION SPECS

100mm Threaded Bottom Bracket Shell

1-1/8"-1.5" Tapered Headtube

Paragon Machine Works Post Mount Rear Disc Brake

197mm/12mm Paragon Machine Works CNC'd Rear Dropouts

28.6mm Front Derailleur Clamp (front derailleur stops optional)

27.2mm Seatpost

30.0mm Seat Clamp

TIRE CLEARANCE

Clearance for 27.5x4.0 or 26x5.0 Tires.

BRAKE CABLE ROUTING

Lower left side toptube zip tie brake cable routing.

STOCK DERAILLEUR ROUTING

Rear Derailleur Cable Stops Stock (front derailleur stops optional)

BRAZE-ONS

2 Sets Of Water Bottle Bosses

Disc Brake Cable Guides

Rear Derailleur Cable Stops

Disc Brake Only

Dropper Post External Downtube Routing - Internal Seattube

Stainless Steel Milwaukee Headbadge, Milwaukee Script And WI State Badges

FORK COMPATIBILITY

100mm Suspension Fork

100mm Suspension Corrected Rigid Fork

*NOTE: Whisky No9 Fat Fork is not included
